title: EOCR-3E420 - Samwha EOCR electronic over-current relay with 4–20 mA output (legacy model)
range_short_desc: Legacy 3-phase electronic over-current relay with a 4–20 mA transmitter output
description: LEGACY MODEL — still supplied by SAV. Samwha EOCR-3E420 three-phase electronic over-current relay in the original EOCR housing, from before the EOCR line was brought under Schneider Electric. The "420" denotes the built-in 4–20 mA current transmitter output, which reports motor load back to a PLC or DCS alongside the relay's own trip contacts. Front panel carries a 3-digit LED readout with Amp and sec indicators, L1/L2/L3 phase lamps, SET/store, MODE·ADJUST, UP/DN and RESET keys, over separate OL and UL output contacts on terminals 95/96 and 97/98. Schneider's current EOCR catalog lists 3E420 under "existing / old model", superseded by the i3M420. SAV continues to stock the legacy part for like-for-like replacement in panels already built around it.

feature_groups.title: Why this record is thin
items: This is a discontinued model and no original 3E420 datasheet survives in SAV's catalog archive or on Schneider's current document server
The figures below are only what can be sourced with certainty: the unit's own front panel, and the replacement table in Schneider's current EOCR catalog
Full electrical ratings — current range, control voltage, trip curves, contact capacity — must be confirmed against the original datasheet or the unit's nameplate before quoting

feature_groups.title: Front panel (from the product photo)
items: Three-phase window (through-hole) current sensing, L1 / L2 / L3 lamps
3-digit LED display with Amp and sec indication
Keys : SET/store, MODE·ADJUST, UP, DN, RESET
Terminals : A1(+) and A2 control power, 4~20 mA output (+ / −), 95/96 and 97/98 output contacts marked OL/UL
Branded "Electronic Over-current Relay EOCR" with the Schneider Electric mark of the transition period

specs.group: Ordering codes (Schneider EOCR catalog, replacement table)
rows: The pairing implies -WR9 is the 24 VDC control-power variant and -WR91 the 100–240 VAC one, following the DB / DU suffixes of the replacement — confirm against the unit's nameplate before quoting
Status : existing / old model in Schneider's current EOCR catalog selection guide
Successor : i3M420 (new digital range, with Modbus RS-485 communication)
Listed alongside 3D420 and 3M420 as the 4–20 mA members of the legacy digital family
SAV still supplies 3E420 for panels already wired for it, where swapping to the i3M420 would mean re-terminating
